# {metadata.title}

The In-Memory Cache Module uses a plain JavaScript Map object to store the cached data. This module is used by default in your Medusa application.

This module is helpful for development or when you’re testing out Medusa, but it’s not recommended to be used in production.

On Cloud, Medusa configures [Medusa Cache](!cloud!/cache), a managed caching service backed by Redis, by default, which is more suitable for production.

<Note title="Development Only">

Use the In-Memory Cache Module only in local development.

</Note>

<Note title="Deprecation Notice">

The In-Memory Cache Module is deprecated starting from [Medusa v2.11.0](https://github.com/medusajs/medusa/releases/tag/v2.11.0). Use the [Caching Module](../../caching/page.mdx) instead.

</Note>

---

## Register the In-Memory Cache Module

<Prerequisites
  items={[
    {
      text: "Medusa application set up locally",
      link: "!cloud!/setup-locally",
    },
  ]}
/>

<Note>

The In-Memory Cache Module is registered by default in your application.

</Note>

Add the module into the `modules` property of the exported object in `medusa-config.ts`:

```ts title="medusa-config.ts"
import { Modules } from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
// ...

module.exports = defineConfig({
  // ...
  modules: [
    {
      resolve: "@medusajs/medusa/cache-inmemory",
      options: {
        // optional options
      },
    },
  ],
})
```
